title: KAPX Index — Market Chronicle ledger snapshot
description:
Monthly frozen snapshot of the public KAPX Index ledger published by Market Chronicle (chronicle.klay-wang.com), together with the append-only hash chain that makes silent edits and silent deletions detectable.

Evidence, not a data product. Each bundle contains VERIFY.md with the exact chain formula so anyone can recompute it without trusting the publisher.

Stated boundaries: readings dated before the site's launch (July 2026) are reproducible backfill computed from public data with the published formula, not an ex-ante record; and the hash chain itself begins later than the launch date. Both are disclosed inside every bundle rather than left for a reader to discover.

KAPX = CNN Fear & Greed Index / VIX. Data and information only; not investment advice.
